project_type: Full-stack serverless EdTech platform - Next.js frontend + AWS Lambda backend + AWS CDK infrastructure
build_system: pnpm workspaces monorepo with turbo for build orchestration
test_framework: Vitest for unit/integration tests, Playwright for E2E browser tests
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install to install dependencies. 2. Run pnpm build to verify TypeScript compilation. 3. Run pnpm test to run unit tests. 4. Run pnpm test:e2e for Playwright tests (requires dev server running).
setup_instructions: 1. Ensure Node.js 22+ is available. 2. Run pnpm install at root. 3. Copy .env.example to .env.local and configure. 4. Run pnpm dev to start development servers.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js v22 via nvm, pnpm available, Bun 1.2.14 available.
contribution_requirements: Modular architecture, DPI-compliant APIs, DPDP Act compliance, multi-tenant design, serverless-first, offline-capable
key_patterns: Greenfield project - establishing patterns: Domain-driven design with bounded contexts, Repository pattern for data access, CQRS for read/write separation, Event-driven architecture with SQS/SNS, Multi-tenant isolation via tenant-scoped DynamoDB keys and Cognito user pools
directory_structure: Monorepo structure: apps/web (Next.js frontend), apps/api (serverless Lambda functions), packages/shared (shared types, utils, DPI integrations), packages/ui (component library), packages/ai (AI/ML service layer), infrastructure/ (AWS CDK stacks), tests/ (E2E Playwright tests), docs/ (architecture documentation)
